conviction_note: Q3 is a price-down quarter that consensus ($1.94 EPS, $2.26B revenue, both down 16% and 9% q/q) already roughly embeds; the swing is the Q4/2027 price guide with China spot now ~90k yuan/t versus a 148k Q3 average, which is public and has been sold (-25% since the August print, 1.4% off the 52-week low, low short interest), so the findings net slightly negative (-0.8) and the scaled number is smaller (-0.42) because p_up sits near 50 on a disputed bar and a washed-out tape.

findings.finding: China domestic lithium carbonate averaged Rmb148,023/t in Q3 2026, down 14.2% q/q (implied Q2 ~Rmb172.5k), and EXW China ended Q3 at Rmb127,750/t, down 20.8% over the quarter; SQM's Q2 realized price ($21.80/kg) sat almost exactly at the Q2 domestic average ex-VAT (~$21.4/kg), which suggests little pricing lag, so Q3 realized likely lands near $18.5-19.5/kg, below management's August 'prices flat vs Q2' guide but roughly inside a consensus that already has EPS -16% and revenue -9% q/q.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Baseline history empty (6-K dates not read). Q2 2026: EPS $2.31 vs $2.03 consensus, price up 23% q/q, stock up about 2% intraday on 2026-08-19 per Reuters via GBM (https://gbm.com/media/noticia/acciones-de-chilena-sqm-suben-tras-superar-previsiones-de-ganancias-y-mejores-perspectivas-en-litio/), then drifted down about a quarter; a price beat did not hold.
findings.why_not_priced: The Q3 price drop is public (China spot, Ganfeng and Tianqi prints) and the consensus has stepped down; what is not settled is that SQM's own 'flat' guide was too high. If the market fully expected a realized price around $19, consensus revenue would be at or below my ~$2.2-2.26B estimate, which it is, so this is mostly priced.
findings.independence: Benchmark Q3 price review, end-Q3 EXW China Rmb127,750/t, -20.8% over the quarter (https://source.benchmarkminerals.com/article/lithium-price-reversal-gets-respite-then-deepens-q3-2026-lithium-price-review, 2026-10-02); Chilean central-bank reference price for September US$19,368/t versus May 21,674 and June 20,825 (https://www.riotimesonline.com/chile-lithium-price-october-2026/); Ganfeng Q3 net profit -68% q/q, attributed to a >20% Q3 lithium price fall (https://www.mysteel.net/news/5144710-flash-ganfeng-lithium-net-profit-soars-19-540-yoy-for-the-first-three-quarters). All are price series or peers, not SQM's own number.

findings.finding: Q4 pricing has fallen far below Q3: SMM battery-grade lithium carbonate was Rmb91,700/t on 2026-11-05 (about 38% under the Q3 average of ~148k), Albemarle said on 2026-11-04 that spot had slipped to about $14/kg against roughly $20 year to date, guided Q4 Energy Storage sales, EBITDA and margins lower, and flagged year-end contract renewals drifting toward Chinese spot; on the 11-18 call SQM must guide Q4 realized pricing sharply lower and give a first read on 2027.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: SQM raised its outlook for three straight quarters (Earnings Whispers 2026-11-10) and the stock still fell about a quarter after the August print, so the market has been selling the forward price path regardless of the guide. No clean record of a guide-down reaction this cycle.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: spot prints daily, ALB said it on its call, and the stock trades 1.4% above its 52-week low and 45% below its high. What could be unpriced is how far SQM's Q4 realized price and its 2027 volume and contract comments fall. If the market had fully priced a Q4 near $13-15/kg, sell-side Q4 numbers would already sit near half of Q2's EPS; I could not source the Q4 consensus.
findings.independence: Albemarle Q3 commentary as reported 2026-11-05 (https://finviz.com/news/417231/albemarle-beats-a-lowered-bar-as-specialties-and-cash-shine-but-lithium-earnings-are-already-rolling-over); CATL Jianxiawo restart rumour pushed futures down ~5% intraday on 2026-11-10 (https://www.mysteel.net/analysis/5148134-lithium-daily-lithium-prices-soft-on-restart-rumor-while-spot-transactions-pick-up); CICC's note that lithium carbonate was down nearly 20% in Q4 to mid-October (https://m.gelonghui.com/news/5326445). Separate sources from finding 1, but the same price cycle.

findings.finding: Chilean customs export tonnage fell about 10% q/q in Q3: lithium carbonate 23.4k + 24.1k + 18.9k = 66.4kt (Jul-Sep) against 29.5k + 19.1k + 21.6k = 70.2kt in Q2, and lithium sulfate to China 7.7k + 16.3k + 9.9k = 33.9kt against 12.1k + 14.2k + 14.9k = 41.2kt. That sits against SQM's guide of Q3 volumes roughly flat at the 84kt Q2 record, and management had already admitted some inventory pull-forward tied to China's export-rebate change.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2's record volume (+59% y/y) came with a ~2% intraday rise and then a fade; volume has not been the line the stock rewarded. Not sourced for earlier prints.
findings.why_not_priced: Customs tonnage is not in any preview I found; the previews repeat the 'flat at ~84kt' guide. It is a proxy: it includes Albemarle's Chilean output (ALB's global volume fell from 65kt to 56kt q/q, which could explain much of the drop), excludes SQM's Mt Holland tonnes, and SQM also sells from inventory held in China, so the transmission to SQM's reported volume is uncertain.
findings.independence: Monthly SMM customs reads: August (https://news.metal.com/newscontent/104103818-smm-analysis-lithium-carbonate-prices-dip-chile-exports-24100-mt-in-august, 2026-09-08), June (https://news.metal.com/en/newscontent/103997065-june-2026-chile-lithium-carbonate-exports-at-21600-mt-lithium-sulfate-exports-at-14900-mt), April (https://news.metal.com/newscontent/103892787-In-April-2026-Chiles-lithium-carbonate-exports-were-29500-mt-and-lithium-sulfate-exports-were-12100-mt), July (https://news.metal.com/newscontent/104053025-in-july-2026-chiles-exports-of-lithium-carbonate-were-23400-mt-and-exports-of-lithium-sulfate-were-7700-mt), May (https://news.metal.com/newscontent/103946119-en-mayo-de-2026-las-exportaciones-de-carbonato-de-litio-de-chile-se-situaron-en-19100-toneladas-métricas-y-las-de-sulfat). All one data series (Chile customs via SMM).

findings.finding: PLS's September-quarter realized spodumene price was US$1,809/t (SC5.2, CIF China), down about 14% q/q; SQM's Australian (Mt Holland) spodumene realized ~$2,048/t in Q2 on about 8.3kt LCE of its 84kt, so the Australian line should step down by a similar share. That is a small segment, net of the Chilean business that carries the quarter.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No record of SQM trading on its Australian segment; it is about 10% of lithium volume.
findings.why_not_priced: A peer's primary document from after SQM last spoke, but on a small segment and in the same direction as the broadly known price fall; mostly priced.
findings.independence: Benchmark: spodumene FOB Australia US$1,780/t at end-Q3, -23.5% over the quarter (https://source.benchmarkminerals.com/article/lithium-price-reversal-gets-respite-then-deepens-q3-2026-lithium-price-review).

findings.finding: Iodine, about 21% of Q2 gross profit, looks stable: China's iodine market held broadly flat through July 2026 after a 0.12% m/m dip in June, and SQM guided iodine prices to stay high with volumes up ~10% y/y. That cushions the lithium price step-down in the rest of the company.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Not sourced; the stock trades on lithium.
findings.source_date: 2026-07 (ChemAnalyst July 2026 market note; exact day not shown)
findings.why_not_priced: Iodine gets little attention in previews built around lithium pricing; but Earnings Whispers notes management warned the iodine tailwind would ease toward year-end, so the upside is limited and partly expected.
findings.independence: SQM Q2 outlook via Quartr: iodine demand +3-4% in 2026, prices expected to stay high (https://quartr.com/events/sociedad-qu-mica-y-minera-de-chile-s-a-sqm-q2-2026_FkzJPIen). Company guidance, not an independent series.

findings.finding: Positioning is washed out rather than crowded: the stock sits 1.4% above its 52-week low, 45.6% below its high and -13.7% over 20 days, short interest was ~0.56% of float and 1-2 days to cover at the last readings found, and open interest is call-heavy (put/call 0.26). A Q4 guide that is merely 'less bad' than spot has room for relief, while a guide-down has less forced selling behind it.

baseline_tension: The findings lean slightly negative, in the same direction as the -13.7% 20-day run-up and the slide to a 52-week low, so the negative is probably mostly priced; skew is unavailable and the thin, call-heavy open interest and low short interest argue against a large downside follow-through, which keeps p_up near 50.
